remarks: Location! West Norwalk/ near the Darien border. Well loved and cared for condo and property, with many upgrades and improvements: Elevator or stairs to your floor- floor 3, Ready to move in. -New hot water heater/pan, new air conditioner condenser/updated heat exchange. Eversource installed new gas meter. Added bookcase/small lower cabinet to both sides of gas fireplace. Crown Molding. Open floor plan. No carpets. Stainless steel appliances. 2 assigned parking spots 8 and 9 in covered parking garage on the 2nd floor. See private storage closet in garage. See improvement list. 1.9 miles to Darien Train station. 1.6 to Rowayton station. 1.2 miles to Trader Joes. Peaceful river and lawn with benches. No flood zone. Ready to move in!
